name: Vanessa Meskida
original_name: ヴァネッサ・メスキダ
source:
"I don’t care if you feel bad or not. What I wanna know is, where’s your apology?"

A brigadier general with the STX Space Force.

Tough to be around and a raging narcissist at the best of times, she treats Gon like a servant, although he never seems to complain.

Once active on the front lines as an elite pilot alongside Ichizo, she now spends her days hunting down this "disgraced fugitive".

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051100]Steam[/url]]
